description: Upload ONE file and attach it to an existing backlog item, then read the item's attachments back to confirm it is there (it will appear in the item's Attachments section in the UI). Pass the file as a LOCAL `filePath` (preferred — e.g. the screenshot path the user shared), or as `base64` + `fileName` when only the bytes are available. Max 20 MB.

base64.description: File content as base64 (when there is no local path). Requires fileName.

contentType.description: MIME type; inferred from the extension when omitted.

entityType.description: Which backlog item to attach to (a defect too).

fileName.description: Name to store the attachment under (default: the file's own name).

filePath.description: Absolute path of the file to upload (read on this machine).

itemId.description: Item id or business key (EP-66, FT-266, US-1326, DE-75).

name: attachment_add
title: Attach a file/screenshot to an epic, feature, user story or defect (SimplifyQA)
